Alice: Heads-up — PR #40122 (search: cached-kv) is blocked by CI. macOS shard failing intermittently on `search_rank_snapshot`. Can someone take quick eyes? CI: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/40122 CI-bot: Build failed: integ-matrix/mac/search-smoke on shard 3. Exit: 1. Logs: ```error: assertion failed at tests/search.rs:312 expected HTML differs by whitespace and a stray emoji ``` Ben: I can reproduce sometimes locally, looks seed-dependent (seed=9421). Can bisect but need a slot. Carla: Is it a snapshot diff or a functional regression? If snapshot only, maybe update after review. Alice: Stack shows `assert_eq!(html, expected_html)` — small whitespace + emoji mismatch, not new DOM nodes. Diana: If it's whitespace/emoji only I'd prefer validating before updating snapshots. Any repro steps? Ben: Local repro command: `CI_DOCKER=1 RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test search_rank_snapshot -- --nocapture` reproduced for me. Diff: ``` -
